item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 6 #MINPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 6 #MINPRSD
Issued at 11:15 PM 15 August 2026

Light to Moderate to Occasionally Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #MisamisOriental(Alubijid, Opol, Kinoguitan, Balingoan, Talisayan, Sugbongcogon, Binuangan), #MisamisOccidental(Plaridel, Baliangao, Calamba, LopezJaena, OroquietaCity, Aloran, SapangDalaga), #SouthCotabato(Tampakan, CityOfKoronadal, Banga, Surallah, Polomolok, T'Boli), #Sarangani(Malungon), #DavaoDelSur(Kiblawan), #ZamboangaDelNorte(Rizal), #DavaoDelNorte(CityOfPanabo, CityOfTagum, Carmen), #DavaoDeOro(Maco, Mabini and Pantukan) within the next 1-2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #MisamisOriental(CagayanDeOroCity, CityOfElSalvador) and #SouthCotabato(Tupi) which may persist within 1-2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
